rows.label: Chipset
rows.value: Intel B760

rows.label: Processeurs / socket
rows.value:
Support for 12th / 13th / 14th Generation Intel® Core™ i9/ i7/ i5/ i3 processors and Intel Pentium processors/ 
Intel Celeron processors in the LGA1700 package
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for CPU support list.

rows.label: Mémoire
rows.value:
Supports Dual Channel DDR5 - 6000+(OC) MT/s, Non-ECC, Un-buffered ,Clocked Unbuffered DIMM (CUDIMM) Memory
 
4 x DDR5 DIMM Memory Slot, Max. Supports up to 256 GB Memory
 
Support Intel Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory modules
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for Memory support list.

rows.label: Sorties graphiques intégrées
rows.value:
Supports DX12
Supports HDCP

rows.label: Stockage et restrictions
rows.value:
Total supports 2 x M.2 socket and 6x SATA III (6Gb/s) ports
 
Intel 12th/13th/14th Processors
 
1 x M.2 (M Key) Socket (M2M_CPU):
 
Supports M.2 Type 2280 SSD module
 
Supports PCIe 4.0 x4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe SSD
 
Intel B760 Chipset
 
1 x M.2 (M Key) Socket (M2M_SB):
 
Supports M.2 Type 2242/ 2260/ 2280/ 22110 SSD module
 
Supports PCIe 4.0 x4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe/ AHCI SSD & SATA lll (6Gb/s) SSD
 
6 x SATA III Connector (6Gb/s): Supports AHCI, RAID 0, 1, 5, 10 & Intel Rapid Storage Technology 

* Specifications vary by CPU types

rows.label: Réseau filaire
rows.value:
Realtek RTL8125B
 
10/ 100/ 1000/ 2500 Mb/s auto negotiation, Half / Full duplex capability

rows.label: Audio
rows.value:
ALC1220
 
7.1 Channels, High Definition Audio, Hi-Fi(Front)

rows.label: USB
rows.value:
2 x USB 3.2 (Gen2) Type-C port (1 on rear I/O and 1 via internal headers)
 
5 x USB 3.2 (Gen2) port (5 on rear I/Os)
 
2 x USB 3.2(Gen1) port (2 via internal headers)
 
6 x USB 2.0 port (2 on rear I/Os and 4 via internal headers)
